scope: Account section only. All 14 screenshots visually inspected. Accessibility scores cover visible presentation only; no interaction behavior was tested.
verdict: The AFTER crops clarify weekly quota and expose named low-resource warnings while preserving the dark design. Unavailable and stale information remain visible. The stale account heading has an alignment regression.

findings.fix: Replace the generic 'Remaining' heading with 'Weekly quota remaining' so the bold 82.8% values have an explicit metric. AFTER resolves this.
Give 'Expand All' a subtle visible button boundary to distinguish the action from adjacent account counts. AFTER resolves this.

findings.observation: Cloud Session Credits at 0% and 5-Hour Limit at 14% occupy separate named warning rows. Their amber 'Low' labels distinguish these values from the white weekly percentages without relying on colour alone.

findings.fix: Name the metric in the 'Remaining' heading so each account's 82.8% is interpretable. AFTER supplies 'Weekly quota remaining'.
Visually separate 'Expand All' from the status text with a restrained button surface or border. AFTER does this.

findings.observation: All three account names and weekly percentages remain readable. Both warning rows fit within their account columns, with labels and values visibly paired.

findings.fix: Replace 'Remaining' with an explicit weekly-quota label and give it space separate from the account counts. AFTER resolves this.
Keep '3 eligible' together and keep 'Expand All' on one line by separating the title/count block from the action. AFTER applies this arrangement.

findings.observation: The stacked rows preserve all three weekly values. Indented warning labels remain attached to their account, and both warning percentages fit without truncation.

findings.fix: Identify the primary percentage as weekly quota in the section heading. Retain the explicit 'Weekly quota unavailable' message beside the missing-value dash. AFTER does both.
Reflow the header so '3 eligible' and 'Expand All' each stay intact. AFTER separates the count block, action, and metric heading.

findings.observation: The long credential name remains fully visible across three lines. Its warning starts below the name. Account 2 retains both 'Weekly quota unavailable' and the dash while separately showing '5-Hour Limit · Low' at 14%; these are visibly different metrics.

findings.fix: Specify 'Weekly quota remaining' in the header so account 3's 'Unavailable' message and dash have a clear metric context. AFTER resolves this.
Give 'Expand All' a visible button boundary. AFTER resolves this.

findings.observation: The '2 loaded · 3 eligible' count, account 3's unavailable status, and its dash remain visible. New warnings belong to accounts 1 and 2 and do not replace the unavailable state.

findings.fix: Name the weekly metric and consolidate the repeated 'Stale' wording into one status beside the percentage, retaining the complete last-observed timestamp. AFTER does this.
Distinguish 'Expand All' from the account summary with a subtle button boundary. AFTER resolves this.

findings.regression: Layout falls from 9 to 8: 'Claude account 3' sits below the other account-name baselines and below its own 82.8% value.
findings.fix: Align account 3's name and percentage with the first rows of accounts 1 and 2; place 'Stale' beneath the percentage and keep the last-observed timestamp below the heading.

findings.observation: The retained 82.8% remains explicitly marked 'Stale'. 'Last observed: Oct 27, 11:00 AM UTC' remains visible, preserving the age context.

findings.fix: Label the summary percentage as weekly quota and add explicit 'Low' text to the amber Cloud Session Credits and 5-Hour Limit rows. AFTER supplies both.
Align the last-observed and forecast blocks across the three accounts and separate them from the resource rows. AFTER adds aligned dividers and metadata blocks.
Increase the small reset-timestamp text beneath the 5-Hour and 7-Day limits while preserving its secondary emphasis. AFTER renders these timestamps more legibly.
Give 'Collapse All' a visible button boundary. AFTER resolves this.

findings.observation: Visible percentages, plan points, reset timestamps, last-observed values, predicted-empty values, and burn rates are preserved. 'Current' remains visible, and textual 'Low' warnings supplement the amber resource values.
